title: Operator learning for efficient quantum computation
summary: An efficient implementation of quantum algorithms is often hindered by the lack of efficient primitives for operators and state preparation. This limits both the ability of near-term quantum hardware to simulate complex problems and the potential of fault-tolerant algorithms to achieve practical quantum advantage. To address this, we propose a framework that maps discrete operators onto compact, structured quantum circuits.
